features: 80 MP Photos + 5 K Video : Capture your world in incredible detail with up to 80 megapixel stills across 11 resolution settings, plus ultra-high-definition 5 K video at 30 fps or smooth 4 K recording at up to 60 fps
Ultra‐Slim & Portable Design : Slim enough to slip into your pocket or bag, the lightweight ZV100 goes wherever you go—perfect for travel, vlogs, and everyday use
Effortless Zoom & Autofocus : Get up close from afar with 18× digital zoom and never miss a moment thanks to fast autofocus that keeps moving subjects crisp and clear

Built‐in Creativity Tools : Choose from 5 preset scene modes (e.g. Normal, Blue Sky, Night View, Portrait), and apply 8 built-in filters like Color, Grayscale, Nostalgia, or even “Dog’s Eye” to stylize your content in-camera
Webcam & USB Export Ready : Transform your camera into a high‐quality webcam with one USB cable, or quickly export photos and videos to your computer for effortless editing and sharing
